A '''laser target designator''' was a targeting device used by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Fighters such as the [[TIE/fc starfighter]] used laser target designators to provide precise aiming data back to a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] or other [[Starship/Legends|ships]].<ref name="SWS" />
